#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

radv-test-sample-graph.xml, sample-graph-resource-type.xml, sample-graph-subintf.xml, simple-sample-graph.xml and t0-sample-graph.xml are using 0 as bgp asn number, can not pass yang validation.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run yang validation, follow https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9700
2. Just check xml can find invalid asn number.

#### Describe the results you received:
bgp asn is 0.

#### Describe the results you expected:
bgp asn can not be 0.
